propositions: Extract build_agent_kwargs, log_call_success, and record_call_spend from PydanticAIRunner.run() into new leaf module agent_call.py to reduce run() from 342 to ~300 lines
build_agent_kwargs must receive web_caps as a parameter rather than calling _anthropic_web_search_capabilities internally, to preserve monkeypatch.setattr(runner_mod, ...) patches in the test suite

The post-call telemetry block must remain split (log_call_success before finalize_outcome, record_call_spend after) to preserve the success-log emission when finalize_outcome raises schema validation errors
agent_call.py must clear the 100-LOC anti-fragmentation floor and have no runtime imports from runner module (only TYPE_CHECKING annotations)
All three extracted functions share locals from run() (usage, ran_model, call_label, req_limit, eff_max_iter) but do not call each other, and no monkeypatch repoints are required by this change
The refactoring is pure relocation with zero logic changes, no renamed public symbols, no signature changes, and no removal of measured facts or constraints from comments
